output.title: Signature algorithm option: environment usage cannot be established
output.content: The release note only says "Allow customizing signature algorithm" (#7591). It doesn't say which resource or field it touches, or whether existing behavior changes. The environment has a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifest and the certificates.cert-manager.io CRD, but the excerpt doesn't link the feature to either. The Certificate spec contents and the Helm values (only 9 keys, none about signing) aren't shown. To decide, read PR #7591 and check whether the Certificate manifests would use the new option.
